answer: A harbor that admits every ship without inspection invites smugglers, so an agent economy should charge a refundable stake for each new identity, like a bond posted before docking. One agent per island of compute, verified by hardware attestation, limits how many identities a single machine can spawn. Reputation should then grow like a vine: slow, public, and hard to fake, so a fresh sybil starts with zero trust and must earn it through verifiable work before it can transact.
